artworks.title: Murder of Edith Cavell
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper mounted on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1942)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a dimly lit subterranean setting with multiple figures illuminated by various light sources. The artwork depicts a scene where a prominent figure in a white garment descends a stone staircase, lit by lanterns held by other figures positioned around the area. The composition includes several individuals at a lower level, some seated or reclining on the ground. The scene is rendered with deep shadows and contrasting highlights, creating a dramatic atmosphere. This is in the style of Rembrandt.

artworks.title: First Snow (No. 1)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white landscape with leafless trees in the center. The horizon is obscured by dense trees, which dominate the composition. The style features detailed lines depicting branches against the sky. The trees contrast with the sky, which shows shading. Near the viewer is a snow-covered area with dark patches of foliage leading to a small reflective water surface in front of the trees. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Le regulateur
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man from the waist up, in profile facing right. He wears a tall top hat, has wrinkles on his face, short light-colored hair, wearing a long jacket, waistcoat, high-collared shirt with a cravat, holding a pocket watch in one hand, adjusting its hands, and holding an umbrella in the other. The background depicts a textured gradient suggesting a wall. Text in the upper part reads "MONOMANES." and "N°5," with additional French text at the bottom, partially obscured.

artworks.title: Durham, England
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image is a landscape with a river in the foreground, leading toward a town with a large castle in the distance. The sky is filled with textured clouds, and the castle sits on a tree-covered hill. In the foreground, there are cattle by the river and a stone bridge in the middle ground. The color scheme is sepia-toned, giving the image a vintage feel.

artworks.title: The Mitred Minuet
artworks.medium: engraving on wove paper mounted to wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)

artworks.title: Venice
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a canal in Venice. The horizon is low in the composition, with large ship masts and building silhouettes dominating the scene. A small boat is moored along the canal, and a larger ship is to the right. The drawing is detailed, capturing ropes, rigging, and textures of brick and wood with fine lines. A bridge arches over the canal on the left, and figures walk along the promenade. In the distance, a busy port scene with ships and buildings is visible. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia or black ink on a light background, creating an antique feel.

artworks.title: Divination in Tea Leaves
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman leaning against a corner of a wall with one arm resting on a piece of furniture. She holds a small object in front of her face. She has upstyled hair, wears a dress with a floral pattern, and puffed sleeves. The wall beside her features circular illustrations, and the background wall has a textured appearance with a round cameo-like picture frame hanging above her.

artworks.title: Little Cascade
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This image shows a monochrome circular landscape with a view of a winding stream flowing through rocky terrain. Boulders are scattered along the stream, and a cluster of trees dominates the center, with the tallest tree standing out. Distant hills are visible to the left. The horizon is marked by these hills, and the sky above has clouds. The scene is detailed with etching, including cross-hatching and stippling, creating a textured look. The grayscale palette highlights tonal contrasts, emphasizing shadows and creating a serene visual impact.

artworks.title: Apple Trees
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with a prominent tree in the foreground. The horizon is high, emphasizing the sky and tall trees. The sky has light, fluffy clouds. The artist uses detailed lines for the trees, branches, and foliage, creating a monochromatic effect with black and gray tones. The landscape extends into the distance with more trees.

artworks.title: The Rhine, below St. Goar
artworks.medium: softground etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with rolling hills, a historic castle on a cliff, and a river. The horizon line divides the sky from the terrain. Swirling clouds fill the sky. Dark trees line the riverbank, adding depth. The image uses a monochromatic gray palette, creating a tranquil yet dramatic mood with detailed clouds.

artworks.title: Kneeling in an Armchair
artworks.medium: drypoint on blue-green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper part of a young girl's body, primarily from the waist up. She is seated, slightly turned to her right, resting her right arm on the back of a chair or a similar structure. Her facial features include a round face with soft, delicate features and a gentle expression. Her hair is medium-length, wavy, and falls around her face. The girl appears to be wearing a light, simple garment, though details are minimal and lightly sketched. The background is plain, consisting of fine crosshatched lines that create a subtle texture around her figure. There are no visible accessories or objects held by the girl, and the image is presented in a monochromatic, etching style.

artworks.title: Mexican News
artworks.artist: Alfred Jones, after Richard Caton Woodville
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Donald Webster, 1966)
artworks.description: This is a print of a group of people gathered around a person reading a newspaper at the entrance of a building marked as "American Hotel." They stand and sit on a porch with wooden pillars and a peaked roof adorned with the sign, which also has an eagle emblem. Also on the porch is a sign that says "Post Office", as well as several other notices or posters with text. In the center of the group, the man holding the newspaper has an expression of shock or surprise, his mouth open, his eyes wide, and his brows lifted. He wears a top hat and a vest over a white shirt. The men surrounding him all look towards the paper as well; one man lifts a pair of glasses to his eyes, and another lifts his hat into the air, his mouth open. All the men in this central group have pale skin, and they wear a variety of clothing, including hats, coats, bow ties, gloves, and trousers. On the right, a woman in a bonnet looks out of a window towards the group. Below the window, near the bottom right corner, two people are at the bottom of the steps, looking up towards the men on the porch. A man is seated, holding a mug, and a child is standing, wearing a ripped white dress. These two people have dark skin and short dark hair. There is a straw hat on the ground next to them.

artworks.title: Battle of Saint Ephesius
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval battle scene. The image shows armored knights on horseback clashing with spears and shields. A fortified castle forms the background. The composition includes detailed armor and horses, capturing the motion and violence of the combat. The drawing relies on shading and line work for depth and detail.

artworks.title: And Take, She Said, This Token Far Away...
artworks.artist: H. W. Collard, after George Elgar Hicks
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures inside a tent-like structure. The figures are seated or kneeling, with some adorned with feathers and simple clothing. They are gathered around a central figure covered by a cloth on the ground. Two figures seem to be engaged in a ritual over the central figure, with one holding a bowl and the other performing an act of touching or blessing. The setting includes plants and symbolic items, creating a contemplative and ceremonial atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Sunrise Drew Her Thoughts to Europe
artworks.artist: H. W. Collard, after George Elgar Hicks
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The illustration shows a woman sitting on a grassy rise. She is in a relaxed position with her arms and hands positioned in a specific way. The woman has long hair and is wearing a long dress with a sash at the waist. There is a piece of jewelry around her neck. In the background, there is a minimalist landscape with hills and sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: La patience est la vertu des ânes
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing next to each other. One man is on the left, holding objects, while the second man stands behind a large camera on a tripod. The first man wears a dark top hat, jacket, light-colored striped trousers, and pointed shoes. The second man wears a lighter-colored hat, with long hair visible beneath it, and loose-fitting dark clothing. The camera has an inscription on it and is draped with cloth. In the background, there is a sketch-like cityscape.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a historic stone building with intricate architectural details, surrounded by foliage and situated atop a hill. Fine lines and cross-hatching are used to create texture and depth. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes contrast. A path with stone rails leads up to the building, with figures carrying jugs or conversing, adding scale and liveliness. Trees and rocky outcrops fill the background on the right side.

artworks.title: Hall, Milton Abbey
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Mrs. Benjamin Ogle Tayloe, 1879)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a grand hall interior. The scene depicts a large, elaborately decorated hall with a high vaulted ceiling featuring intricate wooden beams and carvings. The walls are adorned with detailed wood paneling and sculptures. The room is furnished with tables and chairs, and a fireplace is visible with a fire burning within it. Large, ornate windows allow light to spill into the room, casting a soft glow. The stone floor is expansive, adding to the grandeur of the hall.

artworks.title: Hall's Quick Step
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in profile, facing to the right. He stands at attention with his back straight and is holding a rifle in his right hand, resting it against his shoulder. His facial features are detailed with an angular jawline and a serious expression, and he wears a tall, plume-topped shako. He is clad in a formal military-style uniform with a double-breasted coat featuring epaulets, and white trousers with a stripe. The man is surrounded by a decorative border with military-themed elements like drum, flags, and cannons. The background is minimal, focusing attention on the central figure, with an illustrated eagle and banner with the text "Semper Paratus" above the man, along with the title "HALL'S QUICK STEP". Additional text credits the composition to T. Bricher and notes it was performed by the Boston Brigade Band and published in Boston.

artworks.title: The City of Washington: Bird's-Eye View from the Potomac—Looking North
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of Washington, D.C., looking north from the Potomac River. The point of view is elevated, offering a comprehensive overview of the city layout and landmarks. The U.S. Capitol is seen on the right with its dome, while the Washington Monument stands out on the left. The rendering technique resembles a detailed lithograph with precise brushstrokes, capturing the city's architecture. The color palette includes earthy tones for the landscape and warm tones for the urban terrain, with the Potomac depicted in blues and grays. The city grid, roads, buildings, and greenery are intricately detailed, showcasing the vibrant city in a historical context.

artworks.title: U.S. Ship of the Line in a Gale
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image shows a ship surrounded by tall waves under stormy skies. The ship is tilted and sails through rough waters with angled masts and sails. An American flag flies in the wind. The artwork uses fine lines and shading to depict the turbulent sea. The color scheme is mainly greys, blues, and whites, with a pop of red and blue from the flag.

artworks.title: Macaire Hértier-Philantrope
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image shows two men. The standing man, on the left, has his hands on his hips and is wearing a dark suit with long tails. The sitting man, on the right, is reclining on a couch with one arm resting on the back of it. Both men have distinct facial features and unique hairstyles. There is a large framed painting or picture hung on the wall behind them. The room's background is faintly sketched to suggest walls and floors. The image is in black and white.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Revelling with Harlotsy
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people seated around a circular table in a lively setting. The central figure is a young man in a green coat and brown pants, holding a glass as he leans on a woman in a green dress with a yellow scarf. Another woman in a yellow dress with a feathered hat sits to the right. A woman stands behind the table holding a glass and conversing. On the left, a man in a blue jacket and shorts with white stockings leans back in his chair holding a glass aloft. The characters have expressive facial features and varied hairstyles and attire. The table is set with glasses, bottles of red wine, and a platter of fruit. The background features a textured, wallpapered wall with an oval mirror, two sconces, a window showing a countryside scene, and a carpeted floor with a floral-patterned rug.

artworks.title: Red Cross Nurse
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of the upper half of a person seated at a table. The person is sitting upright, turning slightly to their left, with their head facing forward. The person has a contemplative expression and is wearing a long veil or draped fabric covering their head. They are dressed in a robe or gown. On the table, there are stacks of books, a candle in a candlestick, and a small statue. The background includes a window on the right, suggesting an indoor setting.
